title: Add critical protocol definitions: Field Widget, Plugin Lifecycle, Driver Interface, and Trigger Context
body:
## ✅ Implementation Complete: Critical Protocol Definitions

Successfully implemented **4 critical protocol definitions** that unblock major ObjectStack features:

### 📦 Deliverables

#### 1. Field Widget Contract ⚠️ CRITICAL
- ✅ **File**: `packages/spec/src/ui/widget.zod.ts`
- ✅ **Tests**: 22 tests (all passing)
- ✅ **Purpose**: Enables third-party developers to build custom field components
- ✅ **Features**: Value binding, onChange callbacks, validation states, field schema, custom options

#### 2. Plugin Lifecycle Interface ⚠️ CRITICAL
- ✅ **File**: `packages/spec/src/system/plugin.zod.ts`
- ✅ **Tests**: 17 tests (all passing)
- ✅ **Purpose**: Contract between ObjectOS and all plugins
- ✅ **Features**: PluginContext (ql, os, logger, metadata, events) + lifecycle hooks (onInstall, onEnable, onDisable, onUninstall, onUpgrade)

#### 3. Driver Interface ⚠️ CRITICAL
- ✅ **File**: `packages/spec/src/system/driver.zod.ts`
- ✅ **Tests**: 22 tests (all passing)
- ✅ **Purpose**: Unified interface for multi-database support
- ✅ **Features**: CRUD operations, bulk operations, DDL (syncSchema, dropTable), transactions, capability flags

#### 4. Trigger Context Protocol 🟡 HIGH
- ✅ **File**: `packages/spec/src/data/trigger.zod.ts`
- ✅ **Tests**: 22 tests (all passing)
- ✅ **Purpose**: Standardize trigger code for AI generation
- ✅ **Features**: before/after timing, insert/update/delete actions, doc/previousDoc, validation helpers

### 📊 Quality Metrics

- ✅ **Tests**: 356/356 passing (83 new tests added)
- ✅ **Build**: TypeScript compilation successful
- ✅ **JSON Schemas**: 131 schemas generated (10 new)
- ✅ **Documentation**: MDX docs auto-generated for all schemas
- ✅ **Security**: CodeQL scan clean (0 vulnerabilities)
- ✅ **Code Review**: All type references fixed

### 🎯 Impact

These protocol definitions unblock:
1. **Custom Field Components** - Third-party widget development
2. **Plugin Ecosystem** - Marketplace and plugin management
3. **Multi-Database Support** - ObjectQL data virtualization
4. **Business Logic Automation** - AI-powered trigger code generation

### 🏗️ Technical Implementation

- **Zod-first**: All schemas defined with Zod for runtime validation
- **Type-safe**: TypeScript types derived via `z.infer<>`
- **Conventions**: camelCase for config, snake_case for machine names
- **Comprehensive**: 83 tests covering all use cases
- **Documented**: Auto-generated JSON schemas and MDX docs

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->



<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 完善协议
> 
> 1. Field Widget Contract ⚠️ CRITICAL
> 
> File: packages/spec/src/ui/widget.zod.ts
> Effort: 1-2 days
> Blocks: Custom field components, plugin UI extensions
> Dependencies: None
> 
> Why Critical: Third-party developers cannot build custom field components without this contract.
> 
> Definition:
> 
> export const FieldWidgetPropsSchema = z.object({
>   value: z.any(),
>   onChange: z.function(),
>   readonly: z.boolean().default(false),
>   required: z.boolean().default(false),
>   error: z.string().optional(),
>   field: FieldSchema,
>   record: z.record(z.any()).optional(),
>   options: z.record(z.any()).optional(),
> });
> 
> export type FieldWidgetProps = z.infer<typeof FieldWidgetPropsSchema>;
> 2. Plugin Lifecycle Interface ⚠️ CRITICAL
> 
> File: packages/spec/src/system/plugin.zod.ts
> Effort: 2-3 days
> Blocks: Plugin ecosystem, marketplace
> Dependencies: None
> 
> Why Critical: This is the contract between ObjectOS and all plugins. Without it, plugins cannot be loaded.
> 
> Definition:
> 
> export const PluginContextSchema = z.object({
>   ql: z.any().describe('ObjectQL data access API'),
>   os: z.any().describe('ObjectOS system API'),
>   logger: z.any().describe('Logging interface'),
>   metadata: z.any().describe('Metadata registry'),
>   events: z.any().describe('Event bus'),
> });
> 
> export const PluginLifecycleSchema = z.object({
>   onInstall: z.function().optional(),
>   onEnable: z.function().optional(),
>   onDisable: z.function().optional(),
>   onUninstall: z.function().optional(),
>   onUpgrade: z.function().optional(),
> });
> 3. Driver Interface ⚠️ CRITICAL
> 
> File: packages/spec/src/system/driver.zod.ts
> Effort: 3-4 days
> Blocks: Multi-database support, data virtualization
> Dependencies: None
> 
> Why Critical: This enables ObjectQL to work with any database through a unified interface.
> 
> Definition:
> 
> export const DriverInterfaceSchema = z.object({
>   name: z.string(),
>   version: z.string(),
>   
>   // CRUD
>   find: z.function(),
>   findOne: z.function(),
>   create: z.function(),
>   update: z.function(),
>   delete: z.function(),
>   bulkCreate: z.function(),
>   bulkUpdate: z.function(),
>   bulkDelete: z.function(),
>   
>   // DDL
>   syncSchema: z.function(),
>   dropTable: z.function(),
>   
>   // Transaction
>   beginTransaction: z.function().optional(),
>   commit: z.function().optional(),
>   rollback: z.function().optional(),
>   
>   // Capabilities
>   supports: z.object({
>     transactions: z.boolean(),
>     joins: z.boolean(),
>     fullTextSearch: z.boolean(),
>     jsonFields: z.boolean(),
>     arrayFields: z.boolean(),
>   }),
> });
> 4. Trigger Context Protocol 🟡 HIGH
> 
> File: packages/spec/src/data/trigger.zod.ts
> Effort: 1-2 days
> Blocks: Business logic, trigger code generation
> Dependencies: None
> 
> Why Important: Standardizes how trigger code is written, enabling AI code generation.
> 
> Definition:
> 
> export const TriggerContextSchema = z.object({
>   action: z.enum(['insert', 'update', 'delete']),
>   timing: z.enum(['before', 'after']),
>   doc: z.record(z.any()),
>   previousDoc: z.record(z.any()).optional(),
>   userId: z.string(),
>   user: z.record(z.any()),
>   ql: z.any(),
>   logger: z.any(),
>   addError: z.function(),
>   getOldValue: z.function(),
> });


</details>
